messages.subject: For Robert Bradway | Biotech, government relations and global stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Amgen Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Robert A. Bradway, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

Amgen's global biotech platform operates across governments, regulators, health systems and major investment priorities. That stakeholder environment closely matches my current leadership responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, ESG and stakeholder execution might support Amgen's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Amgen.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
